sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 159)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, syndicated, and educational radio, Paul Rhymer's masterwork *Vic and Sade* across three classic episodes (play money, Uncle Fletcher guarding the porch, and weekend Plant 14 ledger sheets for Crisco), Martin Gabel portraying composer Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky on *Arch Oboler's Plays*, Michael Hansen narrating Malcolm Edwards' dystopian sci-fi vision on *Mindwebs*, and Myrtle Vail's *Myrt and Marge* (1939–1979):
